chunk_size_rationale: largest chunk with < 35 % padding on v2 (measured P2: 27.0 % at 20, 44.4 % at 50); 1.0 s lookahead at 20 Hz
std_floor_rationale: the reach task never moves the gripper, so action[6] and state[7] have zero std; MEAN_STD normalisation would divide by zero — channels below the floor are normalised with std 1

runs.name: baseline
runs.note: SmolVLA's own recipe (2506.01844 §4.3): action expert only, VLM and vision encoder frozen, lr 1e-4 cosine

runs.name: gripper
runs.note: R3: deltas expressed in the end-effector frame at the chunk's first observation (Feng 2602.23408, ZETA 2609.02546)

runs.name: chunkwise
runs.note: R1: cumulative displacement from the chunk's start pose (Feng 2602.23408)

runs.name: plastic
runs.note: R12: VLM + vision encoder unfrozen (Ferchau 2607.10172 found freezing the VLM collapsed pi0 on a real UR5e); lr 2.5e-5 = that paper's full-fine-tune value, so lr is a confound the SDD names
